summary: The boss, The Warden, enters from the top of the screen while the player ship repeatedly releases level-1 charged shots that deflect off the boss's invulnerable shield during its intro sequence.

events.evidence: Player ship flashes with a bright circular pulse and fires a wide arc projectile upward; Cannon HUD shows 1/3 pip used.
Player ship flashes and releases a wide arc projectile upward.
Wide arc projectile hits the boss's front shield while the boss health bar is striped/invulnerable; no damage is dealt.
Player ship flashes and releases a wide arc projectile upward.
Arc projectile reaches the boss's shield and dissipates without dealing damage; loud metallic boss screech plays around this moment.
Player ship flashes and fires a wide arc projectile upward.
Arc projectile hits the boss's front shield and does no damage while the health bar remains striped.
Player ship flashes and fires a wide arc projectile upward.
Arc projectile hits the boss's front shield with no health reduction.
Player ship flashes and fires a wide arc projectile upward.
Arc projectile hits the boss's front shield with no health reduction.
Player ship flashes and fires a wide arc projectile upward.
Arc projectile hits the boss's front shield with no health reduction.

readability_issues.issue: The bright white circular flash on the player ship when charging/releasing completely obscures the player ship model.
Loud boss intro screech/roar masks any subtle shot impact or deflection audio cues.
